# Amrito Kundu

> AI product builder and AI-assisted developer. Python is my main language; I design, build and ship AI-powered apps and developer tools. Open to internships and roles.

Amrito Kundu is a self-taught AI product builder and AI-assisted developer — a vibe coder at heart — who builds software by describing an idea, steering AI, reviewing the code, and shipping. Python is his hands-on language, and he orchestrates other languages, frameworks and platforms with AI assistance. His work spans AI tools, developer tooling, and consumer apps — most with a live demo.

## Projects

- Vidgrab 2.0 — Video downloader for YouTube and Facebook (videos, Shorts, Reels). Search with instant previews; download MP4 up to 1080p or MP3. React + Vite, Node.js, MeTube-powered extraction, Docker-ready. https://github.com/AMRITO-KUNDU/Video-downloader
- LuminaBG — Hybrid AI background remover with seven engines: a zero-upload browser engine, the remove.bg cloud API, and open-source models (U2-Net, ISNet, BiRefNet) on Hugging Face ZeroGPU. React 19 + Vite. https://github.com/AMRITO-KUNDU/Image-Background-Remover
- Scoop — Family-admin app that turns school emails, WhatsApp threads and newsletters into one structured plan using Groq tool-calling, with calendar export and Google Calendar/Tasks sync via Composio. Silver Award, CSC Back-to-School Hackathon; selected for Hackyard Build 2026 at IIT Guwahati. https://github.com/AMRITO-KUNDU/Scoop
- llmScribe — Open-source Python MCP server that gives coding agents structured, deterministic access to a local codebase (no AI, no embeddings, no network). Map, search, read, dependencies, diff and overview tools; CLI and GUI from one core. On PyPI, Apache-2.0, listed on the official MCP Registry. https://github.com/AMRITO-KUNDU/llmscribe
- Wallpaper CDN — A wallpaper API where GitHub is the backend. Drop images into category folders and a GitHub Action publishes images.json to jsDelivr, so Flutter, React Native and web clients read one edge-cached file with categories, full-resolution URLs and WebP thumbnails. MIT. https://walpapercdn.vercel.app/
- Munin — News reader gathering live headlines from ~110 Indian newsrooms, with a feed view, a reels-style stack, and topic browsing. Feeds are normalised server-side; reading state is kept locally. React 19 + TanStack Start. https://github.com/AMRITO-KUNDU/Munin
